headline: JetKVM Mini launches as a matchbox-sized KVM starting at $33
summary: This new KVM device offers 1080p video capture and remote control capabilities in a compact, affordable package. It's available in wired and wireless versions.
details: The JetKVM Mini is a new, compact KVM over IP device, designed to be affordable enough for every machine. It features 1080p video capture, keyboard and mouse control over USB, and a web interface, all housed in a small aluminum case.

Available in two models: the wired JetKVM Mini with Ethernet for $39 and the wireless JetKVM Mini W for $42. Purchasing in packs of three further reduces the price to $33 and $36 per unit, respectively.

The device utilizes an ESP32-P4X microcontroller, which handles video capture and H.264 encoding, eliminating the need for separate DRAM and eMMC. The Mini W model adds an ESP32-C5 for wireless connectivity.

The JetKVM Mini offers two USB ports: one for connecting to the target computer (supporting keyboard, mouse, and virtual media) and another general-purpose port for extensions or backup power. Virtual media functionality allows users to load ISOs from a TF Card.

The firmware is open-source from day one, ensuring the same web interface, cloud access, and update system as the original JetKVM. This includes features like Wake-on-LAN, MQTT integration, and automatic rollback for updates.
An optional JetKVM OS service will be released soon, offering up to 4K screen capture, a shared clipboard, a guest terminal, and file transfer capabilities for the managed machine.
For enhanced security, the JetKVM Mini supports secure boot, allowing users to lock the device to JetKVM-signed firmware. Both models are scheduled for availability on October 26, 2026.
